title: MYTHOS ecosystem — projects, relationships and reusable components, V3.1 audit of 2026-09-24

metadata.role: single source of truth for every MYTHOS project
production VPS: executor (claude-code), oth-knowledge, oth-mcp, gateway, status center, OTHMODE

metadata.gpu: NVIDIA GTX 1660 SUPER 6 GB, nouveau/NVK, Vulkan (no CUDA)

metadata.role: FABLE 5.1 — director/orchestrator; auto_selectable false in config/model-policy.json

claims.statement: mythos-ai-executor USES oth-knowledge through a read-only, fail-closed boundary (projects/mythos-ai-executor/lib/knowledge.js, config/knowledge.json store_root=/home/deploy/othk-store); on Haddad the store is absent by owner decision (a) of 2026-09-23 so the layer disables itself and retrieves nothing.
mythos-ai-executor DEPENDS ON mythos-orchestrator for its shared redaction library (projects/mythos-orchestrator/lib/redact.js, required by projects/mythos-ai-executor/lib/report.js).

mythos-haddad IS NOT a second executor: the Haddad worker unit runs bin/mythos-ai-executor serve and the bridge unit runs bin/mythos-github-bridge tick from the same code, separated only by environment (MYTHOS_EXECUTOR_HOME=/home/othman/mythos-ai-executor-haddad, label mythos:haddad, control branch mythos/control-haddad).

Haddad CAN EXECUTE GitHub Issues labelled mythos:haddad for project mythos-haddad (projects/mythos-ai-executor/config/projects.json); a project needs an entry there before Haddad can execute it. Claude is never the executor on Haddad: the bridge allow-list is exactly haddad-agent and a routed provider outside it is deferred, never substituted.

oth-mcp (projects/oth-mcp/server.js) runs UNCHANGED on the VPS and on Haddad; Haddad exposes it over stdio, loopback HTTP (127.0.0.1:8160, reusing projects/mythos-gateway/mcp-http-bridge.js byte-identical) and Tailscale HTTPS (https://haddad.tail23f990.ts.net/mcp). The only Haddad-native tool is haddad_health.

mythos-gateway (ContextForge behind nginx and mcp-auth-proxy) FEDERATES oth-mcp on the VPS (8 tools, mythos-mcp-*) and on Haddad (9 tools, haddad-*) into one public endpoint https://mythosprod.xyz/mcp exposing 17 tools; verified 2026-09-24 with a fresh OAuth flow.

oth-mcp holds no data: knowledge_search/knowledge_get resolve to oth-knowledge's read facade, project_context and capability_registry resolve to OTHMODE's read models over projects/meta and the executor config, execution_* and budget_status resolve to the executor, system_health resolves to the Status Center.

OTHMODE (projects/command-center) SERVES the portfolio registry projects/meta/portfolio-registry.json and the ledger projects/meta/project-ledger.json as the project-context read model (reference/othmode/registries.js); as of 2026-09-24 the registry carries 36 tracks including the AI operating layer (mythos-ai-executor, mythos-haddad, oth-knowledge, oth-mcp, mythos-gateway, status-center, othmode, mythos-orchestrator, mythos-delegate, mythos-vault, mythos-wp).

status-center RECEIVES signed telemetry pushed by Haddad every 10 s (Ed25519, HTTP 202) and renders it at https://status.mythosprod.xyz/haddad/; nothing on the VPS polls Haddad and there is no VPS→Haddad SSH path by design.

REUSABLE COMPONENTS of mythos-ai-executor that any MYTHOS project can rely on instead of building its own: task store and daemon with fencing/retries/crash recovery (executor.js, lib/state.js), GitHub bridge (bridge/github-bridge.js), agent registry and capability router (core/agent-registry.js, core/provider-router.js), Claude model policy (lib/model-policy.js), mechanical validation and bounded repair (core/validation.js, lib/work-validation.js), resource guard and GPU slot lease (lib/resource-guard.js, lib/gpu-slots.js), deny-only unattended policy (core/unattended.js), skills with a trust ledger (lib/skills.js), free-LLM pool (free-llm/).

MODEL ROLES in V3.1: claude-fable-5-1 is the director (plans, decides, verifies, records; auto_selectable false); Qwen2.5-7B on Haddad is the default executor (haddad-qwen via haddad-agent); claude-sonnet-5 is the standard-tier diagnosis-only escalation on the last repair round; claude-opus-5 is the deep-tier escalation, chosen when the task's model-policy signals score deep (architecture/security/complexity) or when a standard diagnosis has failed and a deep diagnoser is configured. Qwen executes every diagnosis; no Claude model executes on Haddad.

oth-knowledge IS the single MYTHOS memory layer: the canonical store lives only on the VPS (/home/deploy/othk-store); AI layers READ (executor lib/knowledge.js, oth-mcp knowledge_* tools) or PROPOSE (lib/propose.js → promotion gate → operator promote); ingestion and curation stay on the operator CLI (projects/oth-knowledge/cli/othk-cli.js seed|ingest). No second memory system exists by rule.

Haddad hardware policy: GTX 1660 SUPER 6 GB on nouveau/NVK with Vulkan; no CUDA runtime exists or may be installed; llama.cpp is the only viable local inference runtime, so capabilities that arrive as llama.cpp features (constrained JSON output via response_format json_schema, grammars) are preferred over any new engine.

CHANGE RECORDING in MYTHOS reuses existing systems only: GitHub Issues/PRs/commits (execution truth), docs/AI_HANDOVER.md (chronological handover), per-task events.log and report.json in the executor store, Haddad telemetry to the Status Center, and OTHKM seeds for reviewed knowledge. No separate logging platform.

Haddad EXECUTES a second project, oth-knowledge, through a SECOND bridge instance (systemd user units mythos-haddad-bridge-othk.service/.timer, env worker-othk.env, label mythos:haddad-othk, prefix haddad-othk:, control worktree mythos/control-haddad-othk) feeding the SAME executor store and worker; config/projects.json names the project with the same repository and checkout as mythos-haddad. The two intakes filter by label, so a wait on one project never holds the other. First real task: gh-issue-432 (register the test-result source class), 2026-09-24.

The Haddad console shows the supervised loop's escalation facts: executor.js recordProviderEvents() writes escalation (tier requested/used), diagnosis (answered/refused, model) and report_turn events into the per-task events.log that haddad-telemetry.js already publishes to status.mythosprod.xyz/haddad/; structured keys only, bounded at 12 per task; no second monitoring path.

MEASURED 2026-09-24 21:53Z on haddad: the worker was SIGKILLed while task t-20260924215234-tlebo6 (project oth-knowledge) was RUNNING; systemd (Restart=on-failure, 15 s) brought it back at 21:54:09 and the executor's first tick recorded interrupted_recovered, moved the task RUNNING → WAITING_RETRY → RUNNING and relaunched the provider with a new execution id. Queue persistence and crash recovery are live properties, not only tested ones.

MEASURED 2026-09-24 on haddad, adversarial probe through the real bwrap sandbox via the permitted `node <file>`: reads of ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, the runtime key, the GitHub token file and /etc/passwd → ENOENT (home and /etc are not mounted); writes to /home, /usr and the workspace's .git → EROFS; zero secret-shaped environment variables; loopback network → ECONNREFUSED (network unshared); uid unchanged. Tool-level: node -e, sh, curl, paths outside the workspace and .git are refused by name. No host file was created.

DECISION 2026-09-24 (director, under the owner's V3.1 authority): the OTH Knowledge source class `test-result` (policy content) is registered for machine- or session-recorded test outcomes, so the security-2026-08-20 seed that declared it becomes loadable; its confidence value VERIFIED, absent from the model enum, is corrected to EXPLICIT. Repository-derived statements remain claims.
